title: GA-XAI: A Benchmark of Metaheuristic and Classical Feature Selection for Clinical Machine Learning
description: Code and results for the corrected, leakage-controlled GA-XAI benchmark of metaheuristic, explainability-based and classical feature selection (5 datasets, 5 classifiers, 11 methods, 5 seeds, 1,375 runs), together with the parameter-robustness sweep, convergence analysis and WDBC feature-agreement analysis reported in the paper. Release v1.0.0 predates the leakage correction and must not be used to reproduce the paper.
